subregion.name: Central Undercroft
subregion.summary: A dense web of brick chambers and interconnected halls beneath the central quarter of town.

subregion.name: North Storerooms
subregion.summary: The northernmost cellar network consisting of partitioned storerooms and narrow brick passages.

subregion.name: South Cellars
subregion.summary: The southernmost cellar complex featuring adjoining storage bays and foundational halls.

room.title: hidden cellar alcove
room.body: A dirt floor enclosed by stone foundation walls, timber posts, and cave rock.

room.title: rocky dirt passage
room.body: A narrow corridor of dark rocky dirt between stone cellar walls and rough rock, littered with loose papers.

room.title: salt ring alcove
room.body: A cobblestone floor marked with a bloodstained salt ring, beside a bookcase, a lectern, and candles on a barrel.

room.title: timbered stone vault
room.body: Cobbled floor mixed with dark dirt, framed by rough stone walls and heavy timber support posts.

room.title: timbered stone alcove
room.body: Crumbled concrete and cobbles enclosed by ruined stone foundation walls and upright timber beams.

room.title: pillared storeroom
room.body: Crumbled concrete and dark dirt around a central stone pillar, with broken wooden furniture against the wall.

room.title: ruined pillar corridor
room.body: Cobblestone floor between broken stone support pillars, with wooden crates along the wall.

room.title: bloodstained foundation hall
room.body: Cobblestone cellar floor around thick stone pillars, with blood spattered across the masonry.

room.title: ruined partition bay
room.body: A dirt and cobblestone floor between ruined stone partition walls and upright timber beams.

room.title: timbered stone corridor
room.body: Cobblestone floor between broken stone walls and timber posts, with wooden steps at one end and a lit sconce on a pillar.

room.title: timber framed bay
room.body: Cobblestone and dirt floor enclosed by ruined stone walls reinforced with heavy timber posts.

room.title: timber post corridor
room.body: Cobblestone and dirt floor bordered by ruined stone walls with timber posts. Wooden shelving and crates rest along the wall.

room.title: cellar cobblestones
room.body: Cracked cobblestone and dirt floor bordered by rough stone cellar walls.

room.title: brazier cellar
room.body: Cobblestone floor between timber-framed stone walls, with a burning stone brazier and wooden stairs.

room.title: stone pillar passage
room.body: A dark dirt and concrete floor lined with ruined stone walls and brick pillars.

room.title: timbered storage bay
room.body: A cobblestone cellar bay lined with timber posts, with tall wooden shelves against the back stone wall.

room.title: bloodstained cellar hall
room.body: Cobblestone and cracked concrete floor between ruined stone cellar walls, marked with bloodstains and broken support pillars.

room.title: timbered cellar passage
room.body: A cobblestone passage between stone cellar walls braced with heavy timber posts.

room.title: cellar barricade hall
room.body: Cobblestone floor along a stone foundation reinforced with heavy timber planks, beside a low wooden landing.

room.title: bloodstained cobblestone hall
room.body: Cobblestone floor marked with bloodstains and a fallen corpse, lit by a wall sconce on the stone pillar.

room.title: smoldering camp cavern
room.body: A dirt cavern with rough rock walls, a smoldering campfire, and scattered camp debris.

room.title: rocky dirt passage 2
room.body: A dark dirt floor lined with rough rock walls and stone piles.

room.title: stone pillar chamber
room.body: A cobblestone floor bordered by a heavy stone support pillar and ruined cellar walls.

room.title: storeroom doorway
room.body: Cobblestone floor under broken stone walls, with a wooden plank door hung with cobwebs.

room.title: rocky dirt cavern
room.body: A dark rocky dirt hollow under rough stone walls, with clusters of yellow mushrooms along the rock.

room.title: cobblestone passage
room.body: A cobblestone passage between ruined stone cellar walls and heavy timber supports.

room.title: cobbled cellar corridor
room.body: A cobbled corridor running along a row of heavy timber support posts and ruined stone pillars.

room.title: stone pillar junction
room.body: A cobblestone passage between heavy stone pillar bases and timber partition walls.

room.title: ritual alcove
room.body: A rocky dirt passage opening into an alcove with blood, loose papers, and a candlelit stone shelf.

room.title: stone pillar chamber 2
room.body: A cobblestone floor around a heavy stone support pillar, bordered by broken stone walls.

room.title: cot storeroom
room.body: A cobblestone cellar room with wooden posts, a simple cot, and a long wooden table.

room.title: rocky dirt chamber
room.body: Gravelly dirt ground with a cluster of dark rocks in the center.

room.title: barricaded storage bay
room.body: Crumbled concrete and dirt floor inside a small bay enclosed by stone walls and rough timber planks.

room.title: ruined camp hollow
room.body: A dark dirt cavern littered with destroyed camp clutter, bedrolls, and luggage trunks against rocky walls.

room.title: timber partition passage
room.body: A cobblestone floor between a rough earthen wall and a ruined timber partition.

room.title: shelved cellar nook
room.body: Crumbled concrete and dark dirt floor enclosed by ruined stone partition walls and wooden wall shelves.

room.title: torch pillar vault
room.body: Cobblestone and dirt floor around a stone pillar with a lit wall sconce, framed by ruined masonry walls.

room.title: bloodstained cellar hall 2
room.body: Crumbled cobblestone marked by blood and dead bodies around a stone pillar, with a cask resting against the masonry.

room.title: timbered stone corridor
room.body: Crumbled concrete and dark dirt floor framed by ruined stone walls and timber supports.

room.title: gravel cellar bay
room.body: A dirt and gravel floor enclosed by rough rock walls and broken cellar masonry.

room.title: laddered cellar bay
room.body: Crumbled concrete and dirt under timber supports, with a wooden ladder set against the stone wall beside a broken partition.

room.title: ruined camp alcove
room.body: A dark rocky dirt alcove littered with a torn tent frame, a bedroll, and smoldering campfire debris.

room.title: ruined study
room.body: Dirt and crumbled stone floor with a stone fireplace, wooden tables, and bookshelves along the walls.

room.title: torch pillar aisle
room.body: A cobblestone and dirt cellar passage framed by timber supports, lit by a stone torch pillar.

room.title: timber doorway
room.body: Cobblestone and crumbled concrete before a timber door set into a stone wall, framed by heavy posts and roots.

room.title: salt circle cell
room.body: A stone cellar chamber with a glowing salt ring on the dirt floor. Bookshelves line the walls.
